purpose: Teach: 島田/町田/森山/前原/足立/平山/椎名/村田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新任の島田部長を歓迎しろ
lines.en: Welcome our new department head, Shimada.
lines.style: Measured announcement. Crisp attack on the opening word. Even pace, no flourish. The tone of someone accustomed to being heard and obeyed without needing to raise his voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の町田課長の出張日程を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the sales manager Machida's business trip schedule.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient. Quick uptake. Flat affect — not rude, just focused on execution. Slight forward lean in posture, ready to act.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、技術担当の森山主任にプロジェクトを任せろ
lines.en: Assign the technology team lead Moriyama to oversee the project.
lines.style: Steady directive. Deliberate pause before the name to ensure weight. Authoritative but not harsh. The voice of someone placing trust strategically.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報の前原様の戦略を採用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll adopt the PR strategy from Maehara.
lines.style: Clipped confirmation. Rapid delivery, no hesitation. The rhythm of someone who takes notes mentally and moves to the next item without ceremony.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、顧問の足立様にご助言を仰げ
lines.en: Consult with our advisor Adachi for guidance.
lines.style: Clear instruction, slightly softer than before — deference woven in. The name is weighted. Breath before 'for guidance' as if confirming a thoughtful choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の平山様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll have the accounting manager Hirayama prepare the closing schedule.
lines.style: Smooth continuity. Practiced rhythm of receiving and encoding. No strain. Quiet confidence that each instruction registers and will be executed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の椎名様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Have the HR director Shiina handle the new employee orientation program.
lines.style: Steady, final-sounding. Weight on the responsibility being delegated. Slight drop in pitch at the end — this is a key assignment. Trust is implicit.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の村田様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll request that the legal manager Murata review the contracts.
lines.style: Closing confirmation. Warm note underneath — gratitude that the list is complete. Final item energy. Clean, economical phrasing. Ready to execute.
